class.name: HTMLDialogElement
class.brief_description: An HTML dialog that can open in the document or in the modal top layer.
class.description: Represents [code]<dialog>[/code]. A modal dialog and its CSS [code]::backdrop[/code] render above the document. In [HTMLLabel], only the topmost modal accepts interaction. Tab cycles through its focusable elements. After menus and IME handle Escape, [member closed_by] determines whether to request a close.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the dialog. Pass a [String] to replace [member return_value], or leave the argument as [code]null[/code] to keep the current value. The DOM [code]close[/code] event is dispatched after focus restoration, followed by [signal closed]. Returns [constant OK] if the dialog is already closed.

method.name: is_modal
method.description: Returns whether this dialog is in its layout's modal top layer.

method.name: request_close
method.description: Dispatches a cancelable [code]cancel[/code] event and emits [signal close_requested] synchronously for an open, connected dialog, regardless of [member closed_by]. If either handler cancels the request, returns [constant ERR_SKIP]. Otherwise the dialog closes using the same result rules as [method close]. Returns [constant OK] for a closed or detached dialog.

method.name: show
method.description: Opens the dialog in the document. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if it is already open as a modal.

method.name: show_modal
method.description: Opens a connected dialog in the modal top layer. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if it is detached or already open as a non-modal dialog.

members.member: The effective policy for user dismissal. [code]any[/code] allows Escape and clicks outside the dialog within the label. [code]closerequest[/code] allows Escape. [code]none[/code] disables both. A missing or invalid [code]closedby[/code] attribute acts as [code]closerequest[/code] for a modal dialog and [code]none[/code] otherwise. The raw attribute is available through [method HTMLElement.get_attribute].

Reflects the HTML [code]open[/code] attribute. Setting this property to [code]true[/code] opens a regular dialog. Setting it to [code]false[/code] removes the attribute and leaves the top layer if needed.
The result associated with this dialog. The initial value is an empty string.

signal.name: close_requested
signal.description: Emitted synchronously when a script, Escape, or an outside click requests dismissal. Call [method HTMLDialogCloseRequest.prevent_default] in the callback to keep the dialog open. Calls to [method close] and [code]method="dialog"[/code] submissions close directly.

signal.name: closed
signal.description: Emitted after [method close] closes an open dialog and [HTMLLabel] processes focus restoration.
